claims.source_quote_ar: على الاستفهام، بمعنى أى شيء نطلب وراء هذا؟
claims.claim_ar: افتتاح الآية بصيغة استفهامية («مَا تَعْبُدُونَ») كأسلوب بلاغي لاستثارة السامع وإثارة التأمل.
claims.claim_en: The verse opens with an interrogative 'ما' ('ما تَعْبُدُونَ'), a rhetorical question used to provoke the listener and stimulate reflection.
claims.rhetorical_effect: focuses attention, invites reflection and self-examination in the addressees

warnings: Source chunks provided are from Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf) only; the developer list requested al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti and tafsir-balagha sections but those were not supplied. Claims are therefore limited to devices for which supporting source substrings appear in the given chunks.

Only one clear rhetorical-device substring (on the interrogative use of ما) was found verbatim in the supplied chunks; other likely devices in the verse (e.g., restriction with إِلَّا, parallelism/contrast) could not be sourced from the provided chunks and were therefore not extracted.
